$comment: Illustrative MCP tool contract for brain-mcp, reconstructed from the project notes. The consumer is Claude (custom connector). Renaming a tool or changing its args is a contract change.

tools.name: query_knowledge
tools.description: Hybrid search over the indexed vault; maps to titan POST /search.

tools.name: ingest_note
tools.description: Index or re-index a single note; maps to titan POST /ingest/file.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains with chunk counts; maps to titan GET /domains.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Notes related to a given one; maps to titan POST /find_related. Returns two separate signals: semantically similar chunks, and notes connected by hand-written wikilinks (with direction). Kept separate on purpose - a link is different evidence than embedding distance.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List indexed notes grouped by file; maps to titan GET /notes.

tools.name: list_stale
tools.description: List notes whose claims may no longer be true, worst first: agent drafts that were never reviewed, notes with no 'geprueft' date at all, then notes checked longer ago than the threshold. Reads the curation fields titan exposes on GET /notes.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Remove a note's chunks from the index; maps to titan DELETE /chunks.

tools.name: vault_style
tools.description: The house form for notes in this vault. Call before writing or editing one. Returns the note-writing skill plus the hard rules from CLAUDE.md, both read from disk at call time. A session reached through the connector sees neither file on its own: skills do not travel over MCP, and CLAUDE.md is indexed:false.

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Create a NEW note. Enforces frontmatter, checks the domain against the closed list, marks quelle=agent-entwurf and clears geprueft, commits.

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Replace an exact passage in an existing note. Requires the content_hash seen when reading (stale check) and a unique old_text.

tools.name: append_section
tools.description: Append a section to an existing note. No hash needed - appending cannot collide with an edit elsewhere.

tools.name: mark_verified
tools.description: Record that a note's claims were checked today. The counterpart to the writing tools, which clear geprueft. Refuses quelle=agent-entwurf.
